description: Use when an agent tracks large stablecoin flows (whale alerts). Input: chain (ethereum, base, arbitrum), optional token (USDC, USDT), min_usd (default 100000), minutes (Ethereum ≤30, Base ≤5, Arbitrum ≤10), limit. Output: JSON transfers sorted by size: amount, from/to with entity labels (bridges, DEX, protocol contracts) and OFAC SDN flags, mint/burn, tx link, totals. Example: ?chain=ethereum&min_usd=1000000 Price: $0.002 USDC (Base or Solana) via x402.

minutes.description: Look-back window (default Ethereum 10, Base 2, Arbitrum 5; max 30 / 5 / 10). Out of range → 400 before payment

token.description: Stablecoin (default all on the chain; Base has USDC only)

name: stablecoin_transfers
title: Whale stablecoin transfers: large USDC/USDT moves on Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum with entity labels and OFAC flags
